answer: No. Form NW-POA-2 replaced the older notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and your dad can sign NW-POA-2 electronically with no notary. The notary requirement applies only in Georgia, not Virginia. NW-POA-1 forms were accepted only until June 30, 2026, so use NW-POA-2. When you bring the car, bring your own photo ID and the car's documents.
